test.fill_query: INSERT INTO FUNCTION file('test_parquet_read_strings.parquet', Parquet) SELECT if(intDiv(number, 64) % 16 = 0, concat('model ', toString(intDiv(number, 1024) % 100)), '') AS sparse FROM numbers(20000000) SETTINGS engine_file_truncate_on_insert = 1
test.query: SELECT sparse FROM file('test_parquet_read_strings.parquet', Parquet) SETTINGS max_threads = 1 FORMAT Null
